outcome: macronutrient composition of human milk (fat content)
cohort: The study included 45 mothers of 52 premature infants (born at <= 32 weeks of gestational age and/or weighing <= 1500g) admitted to the NICU.
finding: Human milk production on day 4 is a good predictor of production by day 15; maternal age and cesarean delivery appear to negatively influence HM production, and colostrum from vaginal deliveries exhibits higher fat content.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries were associated with a trend toward greater human milk volumes and higher fat content in colostrum compared to cesarean deliveries, which seemed to negatively influence HM production.
